strict_start: Original frozen origin on its native graph node
strict_target: Original eligible exterior entrance on its native graph node
scope: Only source-backed linear walking features, exact shared topological attachments, no added support from area tags alone. Boundary matching may accept projected line drift inside a fixed tolerance but added topology always uses original exact shared native IDs. A path component must link two verified exterior anchors, or one exterior anchor and one suitable known entrance. New edges preserve source direction and source endpoints.
hard_veto: no evidence or missing source geometry
b3: Execute only when 2 or more suitable pre-existing entrances. Evaluate identical origin and B2 graph and retain shortest valid route.
